quizName:
Hardest Questions in Arizona
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: If you must make an emergency stop on an interstate, what should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to get passing cars' attention.
Get out and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if possible.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on the interstate or highway shoulder, turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay inside your vehicle if you can. Highway traffic moves very fast, making it dangerous to stand or walk along the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Roads are slippery and dangerous when wet. This sign warns you that the road surface may cause you to lose control. Slow down when you see this sign because your car will take longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: If a traffic light is green and a police officer signals you to stop, what should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's directions, even if they contradict traffic signals, signs, or road markings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp from the wrong direction.

questions.question: Where is the safest place for children age 12 and under to sit in a vehicle with airbags?

options.text: The bed of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can seriously injure children. All children age 12 and under should ride in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light is permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for vehicles with disability license plates or disability parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: Who can park in handicap parking spaces?

options.text: Only drivers with the appropriate license plate or hanging tag.
Anyone, but only if all other spaces are full.
People who are not feeling well.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only drivers with the appropriate license plate or hanging tag.
questions.explanation: Handicap parking spaces are for people with disabilities. You must have a disability license plate or disability parking tag to use these spaces.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
A left turn is allowed only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop well behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear, then proceed when the gates lift.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop well behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear, then proceed when the gates lift.
questions.explanation: You must stop at railroad crossings when signs, warning devices, or flaggers indicate a train is coming. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of an aggressive driver's way. Avoid competing with other drivers on the road. Working together with other drivers keeps everyone safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: If you become drowsy while driving, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop at the first rest area or service station. Take a nap, stretch, or let another driver take over. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not reliable and may make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: If you are angry after an argument, what should you do before driving?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down.
Drive on the interstate to let off steam.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect how safely you drive. If you are angry, excited, afraid, worried, or sad, calm down before driving. You need to focus on the road without thinking about what upset you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What is the best thing to do if you become tired while driving?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Stop and rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, which makes driving dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, who must yield?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks. You must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, marked or unmarked.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Lack of sleep causes poor driving. Drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and impairs judgment, just like alcohol and drugs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.
